target.statement: UVCOM achieves R1@0.7 = 36.64 on Charades-STA test split (moment retrieval), outperforming UniVTG (35.65) and QD-DETR (32.55)

compute.basis: Training UVCOM from scratch for 200 epochs on Charades-STA with pre-extracted SlowFast+CLIP features is feasible on CPU but slow (est. 8-12 h); pre-extracted features must be downloaded or regenerated, and the repo may not include exact configs.

blockers: Pre-extracted SlowFast/CLIP features for Charades-STA may not be directly downloadable from the repo
Training 200 epochs on CPU is slow; GPU strongly recommended for reasonable turnaround
Exact hyperparameters (lr drop, batch size) are in the paper but code/configs may be incomplete
title: Bridging the Gap: A Unified Video Comprehension Framework for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection
